feature_contract.goal: Restore full fixed-function transformed POSITIONT stereo eligibility for declaration-backed UP and VB primitives without changing legacy FVF or unrecognized vertex declarations.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: Only D3D9 R30 XYZRHW input declaration admission. Preserve renderer, eye state, HUD, SkyGlow, DX11, frozen DXVK and all existing safe fallback behavior.
feature_contract.special_work_evidence: R30 creates VB/IB CPU shadows for FVF-zero layouts but R30PrepareXyzrhwState rejected FVF-zero unconditionally; valid declaration-only POSITIONT never reached its CPU two-eye replay.
trace_stages: Original D3D9 fixed-function draw can bind a POSITIONT vertex declaration whose GetFVF is zero.
R33 delegates transformed XYZRHW UP/VB draws to R30PrepareXyzrhwState, where the old FVF-only check rejects the entire declaration class.
Strict byte-zero stream-zero FLOAT4 POSITIONT validation opens the existing bilateral transform while unknown vertex declarations retain original conservative fallback.
subcomponents: Allow exact declaration-backed transformed UP and indexed UP draw data into existing R30 stereo.
Allow exact declaration-backed VB/IB drawing via existing revision-fenced CPU shadows.
Reject unsupported streams/types/offsets/malformed termination and release COM declaration in all cases.

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Valid declaration-only POSITIONT reaches existing atomic left/right R30 per-eye UP transport.
Valid declaration-backed transformed VB/IB uses original shadow buffer and stereo eye transform.
Legacy FVF is bitwise unchanged; unknown FVF, declaration stream/offset/type/method and missing terminator fail closed.
Mutation guard plus DX9Ex Active Win32 game/host/package, Domain, affected impact and HUD inspectors pass at one exact result SHA.

diagnosis.original_evidence: R30EnsureVertexShadow accepted zero-FVF buffers, while R30PrepareXyzrhwState rejected all GetFVF=0; this is a static reproducible route gap.
source_trace: Original fixed-function POSITIONT declaration is equivalent to transformed XYZRHW float4 at byte zero.
R30PrepareXyzrhwState is common entry for R30 stereo UP/VB.
Existing R30 CPU transform supports float4 XYZRHW independently of FVF metadata.
diagnosis.root_cause: Input layout gate assumes all transformed fixed-function D3D9 vertices are representable as FVF.
alternatives_rejected: Unconditionally enabling FVF=0 is unsafe: unrelated declarations cannot be interpreted as XYZRHW.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: Strict GetVertexDeclaration/GetDeclaration validation, ref-balanced release and old nonzero FVF path preserved.
diagnosis.negative_test_evidence: Source integration with 11 portable fail-closed model cases and 7 negative source mutations.
diagnosis.eye_ownership: No change to draw ownership or eye transforms; shared gate runs before any left/right physical replay.

runtime_evidence: No actual Quest3/VDXR/game testing and no evidence yet that this original game exercises the declaration-only path.
